meta.what: brief-2 GET /api/extras/evacuations answers for California bboxes, from backend/fire3d/api/extras.py as last changed in commit b07e0cb (brief 2, unchanged until brief 3), with the recorded Cal OES samples of tests/test_extras.py; retrieved_ms is Fire-3d's fetch time and is not compared

sources.name: California Evacuation Aggregation Layer
sources.publisher: California Governor's Office of Emergency Services (Cal OES)
sources.license: Public use (data.ca.gov: "No restrictions on public use")
sources.attribution: Evacuation zones: local officials via county GIS and Genasys Protect, aggregated by Cal OES
sources.disclaimer: This information is constantly changing, and Cal OES does not verify or certify the information contained herein.
sources.cadence: Rebuilt by Cal OES about every 5 minutes; current status only

sources.name: County Evacuation Inventory
sources.attribution: County coverage: Cal OES County Evacuation Inventory
sources.cadence: Updated by Cal OES as counties join

caveats: Shown as current status. During Cal OES's 5-minute rebuild the layer can briefly miss zones.
la_zones.issuing_authority: Local emergency officials (county sheriff or emergency services, cities); each zone names its county. Cal OES aggregates and does not verify.

properties.notes: Local authorities are responding to a fast-moving Wildfire. An EVACUATION ORDER has been issued. LEAVE NOW. Your safety is in danger if you stay. Call 911 if you need emergency assistance. Visit Alertla.org for more information.

Local authorities are responding to a Wildfire. An EVACUATION WARNING has been issued. PREPARE TO LEAVE.  Consider leaving now if you need more time to evacuate. Call 911 for emergency assistance. Visit AlertLA.org for more information.
